about.label: Our story
about.body: Marisol went to compete — and came back with awards and one idea fixed in her head: do this right, no shortcuts. DiMOE grew alongside its regulars until it earned its own place in Champa: terrace, courtyard and wood-fired oven. Same flavour. Much more room to share it.
about.h1_desc: Fresh mozzarella, San Marzano tomatoes, 48-hour fermented dough. The same ingredients as Naples, no compromises.
about.h2_desc: Recognized by @thetopchile among the country's best. A distinction that reflects what our guests already knew.
about.h3_desc: Your pet is welcome on our terrace and outdoor courtyard. More space for everyone since we moved to our new location.
about.h4_desc: Vegetarian, vegan, or everything in between — there's something for everyone. Because a great evening shouldn't leave anyone out.
about.banner_desc: Darío Pavez 16, Champa, Paine · Terrace · Courtyard · Free parking · 5 min from Metrotren

menu.c1_desc: 48-hour fermented dough, stone oven at 450°C. Neapolitan and pan-style. The difference is real.
menu.c2_desc: Artisan recipes with sauces made fresh to order. Nothing from a packet.
menu.c3_desc: Craft cocktails and Italian classics, carefully executed. The Negroni you've been waiting for.
menu.c4_desc: Starters, wines, desserts and more. Options for everyone: vegetarian, vegan and meat dishes.
